name: 拆迁（补偿/评估/政策）计算

map.📋 拆迁（补偿/评估/政策）计算: 📋 Demolition Compensation, Valuation and Policy Calculator
map.拆迁补偿计算工具，根据房屋面积、评估单价和补偿标准计算房屋补偿、搬迁费、临时安置: A demolition compensation calculator deriving housing compensation, moving allowance, temporary rehousing allowance and incentive payments from floor area, appraised unit price and compensation standards.
map.📖 查看「拆迁（补偿/评估/政策）计算 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Demolition Compensation, Valuation and Policy Calculator User Guide"
map.拆迁补偿 = 重置价 × 成新率 + 区位: Demolition compensation = replacement price × condition rate + location
map.房屋补偿费=面积×评估单价，以评估价值为基准: Housing compensation = area × appraised unit price, on the basis of the appraised value
map.临时安置费按月计算，住宅一般6-24个月: Temporary rehousing is charged monthly, typically 6-24 months for housing
map.按期签约和搬迁可获得奖励金: Signing and relocating on time earns an incentive payment
map.商铺/厂房拆迁还需补偿停产停业损失: Demolition of shops or factories also compensates for business interruption losses
map.拆迁前估算房屋补偿、临时安置、搬迁与奖励。: Estimate housing compensation, temporary rehousing, moving and incentives before demolition.
map.对比货币补偿与产权调换哪种更划算。: Compare which works out better, cash compensation or property exchange.
map.商铺/厂房额外计入停产停业损失。: Add business interruption losses separately for shops and factories.
map.住宅 100㎡×单价 8000 元=房屋补偿 80 万；临时安置 100×20: Housing: 100 sqm × 8000 yuan gives compensation of 800,000; temporary rehousing 100 × 20 yuan/month × 12 months = 24,000; moving allowance 2000 yuan; on-time signing incentive 5% × 800,000 = 40,000; total about 866,000 yuan.
map.选等面积调换则不加房屋补偿现金，但仍有临时安置与搬迁费；商铺还需加停产停业损失（: Choosing equal-area exchange withholds the cash housing compensation, but temporary rehousing and moving allowances still apply; shops additionally need business interruption losses (by earnings or area).
map.奖励金必须拿吗？: Must the incentive payment be taken?
map.奖励是限时签约/搬迁的额外补助，放弃时限则无，金额按当地政策（常见 3%–8%）: It is an extra grant for signing or relocating within the deadline; miss the window and it lapses. The amount follows local policy (commonly 3%-8%).
map.对评估值有异议怎么办？: What if I disagree with the appraised value?
map.可申请复核评估或专家鉴定，签约前应看清补偿方案明细，必要时咨询专业律师。: Apply for a review appraisal or expert determination; read the compensation breakdown carefully before signing and consult a lawyer where needed.
